description: This file contains the implementation of the 'search_10and8i40' function, which searches for the best codevector by determining the positions of 8 or 10 pulses in a 40-sample frame for AMR speech codec. It includes detailed algorithms for pulse position search, with specific optimizations for different GSM/AMR standards.

methods.name: search_10and8i40
methods.description: Performs pulse position search for 8 or 10 pulses in a 40-sample frame, optimizing for maximum correlation and energy, used in AMR speech codec.
